messages:
maria-support: Hey team — customer cust_10299 reports invoice INV-2024-0991 charged 19% VAT. Their PO explicitly lists company VAT as 'DE 123.456.789' and marks as B2B. They attached PO and say portal shows validated VAT.

rafael-billing: Looking now. If the system treated it as domestic consumer it would pick billing country rate (NL 21% or DE 19% depending). Can you share invoice PDF + PO?

maria-support: PDF uploaded: https://redwood.internal/attachments/INV-2024-0991.pdf. PO text: "VAT ID: DE 123.456.789 (validated) - reverse charge applies". Billing address on record is NL.

rafael-billing: Pulled invoice. Tax log indicates VAT_ID detected but flagged as invalid_format -> fallback to billing_country=NL -> rate=0.21 applied. Txn id txn_a1c3d9.

luke-eng: Quick hypothesis: two different VAT parsing routines exist. Our front-end sanitizer strips punctuation but the PO ingestion path didn't. Validator expects compact form (DE123456789) and rejects dots.

maria-support: I can paste the sanitized payload that was passed to billing (redacted):

```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust_10299",
  "po_number": "PO-99011",
  "amount": "15000",
  "billing_country": "NL",
  "business_vat": "DE 123.456.789",
  "tax_exempt": "true"
}
```

luke-eng: Confirmed. ingestion pipeline kept the dotted VAT. Fix will be to normalize (strip non-alphanum + uppercase) in ingestion and tax service, and to honor explicit tax_exempt flag + business_vat when validation succeeds. I'll prepare a patch and tests.

emily-legal: For the credit note wording, we need exact EU reverse charge phrasing: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Article 194 of the VAT Directive." Also include original VAT amount and invoice reference.

rafael-billing: Plan: 1) hotfix to sanitize VAT on ingestion + validator improvement (deploy to staging) 2) regenerate corrected invoice INV-2024-0991-R with 0% VAT and reference reverse charge language 3) issue credit note CR-2024-0107 referencing original VAT amount and include legal wording 4) notify customer.

luke-eng: PR #4782 opened (vat-ingest-sanitize). Staging deploy green. Will roll to prod after smoke tests ~45m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Staging deploy completed for service=vat_ingest at 2025-02-14T14:12:02Z, build=3f2a1b :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Production deploy completed for service=vat_ingest at 2025-02-14T15:04:10Z, build=3f2a1b :white_check_mark:

luke-eng: Patch live. Recalculated txn_a1c3d9 on prod: business VAT normalized to DE123456789, validator OK, reverse charge applied (rate=0.0). Generated corrected invoice INV-2024-0991-R and credit CR-2024-0107 created with required text.

rafael-billing: Sent corrected invoice + credit to cust_10299. Mail copy attached in thread. Keeping ticket open 48h for confirmation.

maria-support: Customer replied: "Received corrected docs, thanks — confirmed reverse charge applied." Closing after 48h if no regression.

luke-eng: Follow-up: create lint in ingestion to auto-sanitize VAT and log a warning when original had punctuation (ENG-3290). Also add an end-to-end test for PO ingestion -> tax calc -> invoice generation.

maria-support: Thanks all :raised_hands:
